result:
Compiled successfully on the first attempt.

The test class `CSVFormatAgentTest` (in `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java`) covers:

- All predefined formats' documented field values (`DEFAULT`, `EXCEL`, `RFC4180`, `TDF`, `MYSQL`, `ORACLE`, `POSTGRESQL_CSV/TEXT`, `MONGODB_CSV/TSV`, `INFORMIX_UNLOAD(_CSV)`)
- `newFormat(char)` including its documented `IllegalArgumentException` for line-break delimiters
- `valueOf(String)` for all predefined names plus invalid-name and `null` error cases
- `Builder.create()`, `create(CSVFormat)`, `get()`/`build()` round-tripping, and immutability of already-built instances
- `copy()`, static `copy(CSVFormat)` null-safety, and `clone(T...)` null-safety/defensive-copy semantics
- `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString` contract (reflexive, distinct formats unequal, null/other-type unequal, consistency)
- Defensive copies for `getHeader()`/`getHeaderComments()` and the Builder's `setHeader`/`setHeaderComments`
- Round-trip getter/setter behavior for every boolean/char/String/enum setting exposed via `Builder`
- `format(Object...)` quoting/escaping/null-string behavior and empty-args boundary
- `print(Object, Appendable, boolean)`, `println(Appendable)`, `printRecord(Appendable, Object...)` including trailing-delimiter and no-separator boundary cases
- `print(Appendable)`, `print(File, Charset)`, `print(Path, Charset)`, `printer()` and `parse(Reader)`
- Deprecated bridge methods (`withDelimiter`, `withEscape`, `withQuote`, `withCommentMarker`, `withRecordSeparator`, `withHeader`, `withAllowMissingColumnNames`, `withIgnoreSurroundingSpaces`, `withFirstRecordAsHeader`, `getDelimiter`, `getAllowDuplicateHeaderNames`) including their error cases

All assertions are grounded in the documented contracts in `api/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormat.html`, `CSVFormat.Builder.html`, and `CSVFormat.Predefined.html`. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK` (only a harmless deprecation note from exercising the deprecated API surface).
